# FDG3056

> DO add the suffix “Exception.”

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.2 Names of Common Types. Applies to: System.Exception.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1710
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

CA1710 reports a class derived directly from System.Exception whose name does not end with Exception; with its default dotnet_code_quality.CA1710.exclude_indirect_base_types = true it does not report a class derived from another exception class, such as ArgumentException (probe with SDK 10.0.402), so coverage is partial. Renaming a public type changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1710 has no code fix.
